preliminary_pixel_observation.observation: The selected 854x480 frames are text/graphic-first, not character footage: a pale near-white field carries cyan horizontal bands, thin cyan rules/diagonals, circular/arc geometry and corner-like framing marks. At source n240-241 a short Japanese line sits centered within the light band; exact letter identity is tentative from this raster and is not used as a transcript. At n299-300 the center switches to much larger saturated cyan-blue Japanese forms with a darker edge/offset; a short string appears to read 「あいつ」, while nearby small Roman/secondary text is too small to assert. At n358-359, large blue Japanese glyphs are slanted/cropped by the frame and remain unreadable as a complete phrase. Broad composition is clean and sparse, with text occupying the focal center and no photographic/character subject. A small lower-right branding mark is present and treated as watermark/tool branding, not timed lyric. No source font, editable vector, or effect graph can be identified from rendered pixels.
preliminary_pixel_observation.before_during_after: The six inspected samples cover the beginning, a middle adjacent pair, and the last adjacent pair in the two-second window. n240/241 share the centered line; n299/300 share a centered heavy blue line; n358/359 show a different enlarged, cropped/angled glyph arrangement. These are sampled states only, not a continuous transition curve or claim about every intervening frame.

readable_timed_text: ちゃんと覚悟しといてよ？

preliminary_pixel_observation.observation: A rounded-rectangle lime-green panel with dark-blue repeated uppercase 'ARE YOU READY?' text acts as a framing border inside a pale graph-paper-like outer field; small colored corner marks sit outside it. Inside is a compact night-sky illustration: dark navy sky, gray clouds, a large angular yellow lightning bolt, green scalloped vegetation and two black foreground silhouettes with pointed appendages and yellow star-like eyes (identity not inferred). The main Japanese line sits across the upper-middle of the illustration. Most kana are pale pink with a thick dark navy/purple edge or offset; the central kanji 覚悟 is much larger, yellow, and has a dark blue offset/extruded edge. The repeated English phrase is visually integrated as a border, not established as software UI. The main phrase remains legible in all six selected samples. Adjacent middle frames n2183-2184 retain the same general placement; near the closing pair n2206-2207 a localized bright yellow-white lightning-like flare is visible behind/near the central characters. This small sampled change does not establish a continuous glow/noise phase or global effect.
preliminary_pixel_observation.before_during_after: Opening pair n2160/2161, middle pair n2183/2184 and closing pair n2206/2207 were read. The phrase and border persist at those samples, while some scene/light details vary. No full transition, camera path, or beat relation is established.
limits: Japanese phrase is visible text in the sampled render; its relationship to exact sung timing/audio was not tested.
The black figures are described only by visible silhouette features; no rabbit, character-model, or MMD identification.
The filename/title/uploader do not prove an edit graph or identify software layers.
Whole lyrics, audio, beat, author intent, typeface identity and font license were not inspected.
